Stating bacteria as fact is risky; if kept it needs 'is thought to' and a source that says so, otherwise reject.

Unsure this specific behavior (breaching the shell then dribbling saliva into the opening) is documented for the greater blue-ringed octopus (Hapalochlaena lunulata) rather than octopuses generally; blue-ringed octopuses are also described biting or releasing saliva into water near prey.
